tickerText: [TENNIS] Indoor season opens Monday as ATP 500 Vienna and Basel join WTA Tokyo and Guangzhou; Alycia Parks topped Xinyu Wang 6-1, 7-6(7) in Tokyo and meets Maja Chwalinska next while Basel hosts Holger Rune vs Quentin Halys and Casper Ruud vs Dominic Stricker • [SQUASH] Sivasangari Subramaniam and Mohamad Zakaria swept the PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open crowns in Redwood City; Sivasangari beat Farida Mohamed 11-7, 11-6, 11-8 for her fourth title of 2026 and Zakaria took the men's trophy after Victor Crouin fell in the final • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open closed at Arena Grand Paris with An Se-young rallying past P.V. Sindhu 16-21, 21-11, 21-12 for a fourth women's crown, Christo Popov edging Moh. Zaki Ubaidillah 21-11, 14-21, 21-13, and Feng Yan Zhe/Huang Dong Ping winning a third straight mixed doubles title • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Tour Asia's season ended at Kai Tak as Hunter Johnson beat Tama Shimabukuro 11-4, 6-11, 11-7 for men's singles, Andie Dikosavljevic swept Judit Castillo 11-1, 11-5 in women's singles, and Anna Leigh Waters doubled up in women's doubles and mixed • [TABLE TENNIS] Tomokazu Harimoto rallied from two sets down to beat Li Tianyang 1-11, 9-11, 11-7, 11-8, 11-7 for men's singles gold at the ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent; Chen Yi took women's singles and China swept both doubles finals as continental champions were crowned worldwide on Road to Astana

newsItems.title: Four-Tournament Monday
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Vienna and Basel and WTA Tokyo and Guangzhou all begin main-draw week on October 26; Alycia Parks opened Tokyo with a 6-1, 7-6(7) win over Xinyu Wang and advances to face Maja Chwalinska.

newsItems.title: French Open Wrap
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young came from a set down to beat P.V. Sindhu for her fourth French Open women's singles title, Christo Popov won the men's final in three games, and Feng Yan Zhe and Huang Dong Ping claimed a third consecutive mixed doubles crown in Paris.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Slam Champs
newsItems.excerpt: The Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam crowned Hunter Johnson over Tama Shimabukuro in three games and Andie Dikosavljevic over Judit Castillo in straight games, closing the PPA Tour Asia season at Kai Tak Arena.

newsItems.title: Harimoto's Tashkent Rally
newsItems.excerpt: Tomokazu Harimoto saved match point drama with a 3-2 comeback against Li Tianyang to win men's singles at the ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships; Chen Yi took women's gold as China swept both doubles titles in Uzbekistan.
